headline: UCL: Why we lost 4-1 to Como – Man United’s captain Bruno Fernandes
standfirst: Man United captain Bruno Fernandes said his side lacked belief as their woes continued with a humiliating 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como on Wednesday.
body_markdown:
Man United captain Bruno Fernandes said his side lacked belief as their woes continued with a humiliating 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como on Wednesday. Man United fell behind to a second-minute goal and never recovered as the club’s winless run reached seven games after another lacklustre performance. “We started on the wrong foot, and they scored very early,” Fernandes told TNT Sports. (Vanguard)

**Jamaica Observer** adds: COMO, Italy (AFP)—Manchester United's struggles deepened with a dismal 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como on Wednesday, piling further pressure on under-fire manager Michael Carrick. Argentina international Nico Paz struck twice, either side of a goal from Tasos Douvikas, before Jacobo Ramon added a fourth for the Italians.

**ESPN Soccer** adds: Manchester United coach Michael Carrick and captain Bruno Fernandes appeared to trade criticism of each other after Carrick's future was thrown into doubt following a humiliating 4-1 defeat to Como.

**BBC Sport** adds: Manchester United skipper Bruno Fernandes has blamed head coach Michael Carrick for the tactics that led to an embarrassing 4-1 defeat by Como in the Champions League.
